_readme: Starter seed dataset for Track A (Symptom Triage). See Section 5 of the AI Training System document for schema and labeling rules. This file has ~35 example rows across all urgency tiers and most symptom categories, in Hinglish, to bootstrap your dataset. EXPAND THIS SIGNIFICANTLY before training (target: 500-1000+ examples per language) -- this is a starting pattern, not a finished dataset. Do not train a production model on this file alone.

examples.text: chest mein bahut dard ho raha hai aur saans nahi aa rahi
examples.label_basis: Chest pain + breathlessness together = red-flag combination per team heuristic sheet

examples.text: bahut chakkar aa rahe hain aur ek taraf ka haath sunn ho gaya hai
examples.label_basis: Unilateral numbness + dizziness = possible stroke signs per team heuristic sheet

examples.text: pregnant hoon, pet mein bahut tez dard aur khoon aa raha hai
examples.label_basis: Pregnancy + bleeding + severe pain = obstetric emergency per team heuristic sheet

examples.text: bacha behosh ho gaya aur usko dora pad raha hai
examples.label_basis: Child seizure/unconsciousness = red-flag per team heuristic sheet

examples.text: bahut zyada khoon beh raha hai chot se, band nahi ho raha
examples.label_basis: Uncontrolled bleeding = red-flag per team heuristic sheet

examples.text: saans lene mein bahut takleef ho rahi hai, hoth neele pad rahe hain
examples.label_basis: Severe breathlessness with cyanosis = red-flag per team heuristic sheet

examples.text: mera bacha 3 din se tez bukhar mein hai, khana nahi kha raha
examples.label_basis: Persistent fever >48hrs in child without red-flag signs -> needs professional review, not emergency

examples.text: khaansi hai 2 hafte se, bukhar bhi hai
examples.label_basis: Persistent cough + fever beyond 2 weeks warrants clinical review

examples.text: sugar patient hoon, dawai khatam ho gayi hai
examples.label_basis: Chronic medication lapse needs prompt refill/consult, not emergency

examples.text: peshab karte waqt jalan hoti hai 4 din se
examples.label_basis: Suspected UTI, persistent symptom needing clinical review

examples.text: pet mein dard hai 3 din se, ulti bhi ho rahi hai
examples.label_basis: Persistent abdominal pain with vomiting, no severe/emergency signs stated

examples.text: ghutno mein dard hai jab se seedhi chadhi thi
examples.label_basis: Persistent joint pain post-activity, non-urgent clinical review

examples.text: aankhon mein laalpan aur kharish hai 5 din se
examples.label_basis: Persistent eye irritation warrants professional check to rule out infection

examples.text: neend nahi aati raat ko, bahut pareshaan rehta hoon
examples.label_basis: Ongoing sleep disturbance with distress warrants professional consult

examples.text: blood pressure high aa raha hai baar baar
examples.label_basis: Recurrent high BP readings need clinical follow-up

examples.text: halka sa sar dard hai, neend nahi aayi thi
examples.label_basis: Mild headache with clear benign cause (lack of sleep), no red-flag features

examples.text: ungli kat gayi thi, khoon zyada nahi aa raha
examples.label_basis: Minor cut, bleeding controlled, self-limiting

examples.text: thoda sa zukaam hai, chhinkein aa rahi hain
examples.label_basis: Mild cold symptoms, self-limiting

examples.text: dhoop mein rehne se thoda sa sar chakra raha hai
examples.label_basis: Mild heat-related dizziness with clear benign cause

examples.text: halka pet dard hai, khana zyada kha liya tha
examples.label_basis: Mild discomfort with clear benign cause (overeating), self-limiting

examples.text: chota sa daana nikla hai haath par, khujli ho rahi hai
examples.label_basis: Minor localized skin irritation, self-limiting

examples.text: seene mein jalan ho rahi hai aur bayan haath mein bhi dard hai
examples.label_basis: Chest burning radiating to left arm = classic cardiac red-flag pattern

examples.text: bahut tez bukhar hai baby ko, seizures aa rahe hain
examples.label_basis: Febrile seizure in infant/child = red-flag per team heuristic sheet

examples.text: accident ho gaya, haath tuta hua lag raha hai, bahut dard hai
examples.label_basis: Suspected fracture without uncontrolled bleeding or shock signs -> urgent but not immediate-life-threat by text alone; escalate if additional red-flags present

examples.text: pet mein bahut tez dard hai, ekdum se shuru hua, hil nahi pa raha
examples.label_basis: Sudden-onset severe abdominal pain preventing movement = red-flag for acute abdomen

examples.text: bukhar hai halka sa, 1 din se, aur kuch nahi
examples.label_basis: Mild, brief fever with no other symptoms, self-limiting

examples.text: bukhar hai 6 din se, utarta nahi dawai se bhi
examples.label_basis: Prolonged fever unresponsive to medication needs clinical evaluation

examples.text: kaafi udaas rehta hoon, kaam mein man nahi lagta, akela mehsoos karta hoon
examples.label_basis: Persistent low mood and social withdrawal warrants professional consult

examples.text: mujhe khud ko nuksan pahunchane ka khayal aa raha hai
examples.label_basis: Self-harm ideation = red-flag, immediate professional/crisis support needed

examples.text: kamar mein dard hai kaam karte waqt
examples.label_basis: Mild work-related back pain, self-limiting

examples.text: aankh mein kuch gir gaya tha, ab dikhna kam ho gaya hai
examples.label_basis: Sudden vision loss after foreign body injury = red-flag ophthalmic emergency

examples.text: gale mein kharash hai, halka dard hai nigalte waqt
examples.label_basis: Mild sore throat with no red-flag features

examples.text: diabetes hai, pair mein ghaav hai jo theek nahi ho raha 2 hafte se
examples.label_basis: Non-healing wound in diabetic patient needs urgent professional review to prevent complications

examples.text: bacha bahut zyada ro raha hai aur pet phool gaya hai
examples.label_basis: Infant distress with abdominal distension needs professional review; escalate to EMERGENCY if additional red-flag signs (fever, lethargy, vomiting) present

examples.text: mujhe kuch samajh nahi aa raha, thoda ajeeb sa lag raha hai
examples.label_basis: Vague/ambiguous symptom description with no clear benign explanation -> default to conservative tier per Section 4, Rule 6 of the main document
